description: Mark an application on the list as submitted (the user finished submitting on the employer site). Uses 1 Auto Apply credit if this one has not been charged yet; nothing while unlimited is active. Replies with the status as read back. Uses the user's minutes or credits or creates a payment; tell the user what it costs and get their agreement first. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope job_applications:write.)

applicationId.description: Application id, from list_job_applications or the reply of an add-to-list tool
